feature: Authored Swamp Lizard spawn admission into the generic enemy CombatSession
status: existing components are individually usable; normal authored trigger-to-session composition remains a root integration gap

visual_evidence.version_caveat: Supplied reference identifies v1.0.3; local game/content version match is not established.

observed_frames.observation: Skip prompt is visible; two green enemy-shaped figures occupy the same corridor, one near the patterned floor and another above/behind the wall. The still does not prove their exact animation phase or identity.

Combat Tutorial overlay is shown with the player below the corridor and an enemy above/behind the wall. This is consistent with a scripted entrance followed by tutorial admission, but does not establish which source actor is visible.
A green enemy corpse lies on the floor near the player, with a gold loot message and gameplay HUD. This is a later visual result, not proof of exact spawn timing or actor identity.

visual_evidence.expected_invariant: The first authored encounter starts from the real one-shot trigger, spawns its two already-declared Lizard actors in script order into the current actor/session owners, and later allows ordinary combat/death. No extra enemy population is needed.

source_chain.trigger_gates: CanonicalTriggerZoneV22 owns enabled/count/delay, local-player alive/online/door qualification, actual contact and enter edge; it starts the resolved source script once. OriginalCampaignRuntime::trigger_contact retains count/delay/edge/start state after receiving inside and qualified facts; it is not the collision/condition owner.
source_chain.script: LizardMan_Intro indices4 and6 are Script_SpawnCharacter kind30 for _prim_Monster_LizManIntro1 and _prim_Monster_LizManIntro2, separated by source waits500ms and1500ms. The script first runs a common block-save child, locks controllers and changes camera before these spawn calls.
source_chain.initial_actor_state: Both MGP Character declarations have ai_state=Limbus, auto_spawn=0 and ai_state_visible=0. Level::_LoadCharStates0x3eff98 maps Limbus0/PreSpawn17 to PreSpawn17. OriginalActorLifecycle.add derives that state from authored facts; the intro declarations begin disabled/without collision under the source PreSpawn policy.
source_chain.spawn_command: Script_SpawnCharacter Execute45f400 resolves the named Character in the current source module and calls SM_SetSpawnState(false,false). The source transition is PreSpawn17 -> Spawn1; PreSpawn blur enables/revives/enables collisions, Spawn focus sets source flags/selects the authored Spawn sequence/clears target/syncs last target/cancels sneaking, and whole-sequence completion event34 moves Spawn1 -> Idle3.

existing_typed_owners.trigger_to_script: CampaignBinding::trigger_script_services(TriggerZoneServicesV22&) resolves the source local script ID and binds start_script to the same OriginalCampaignRuntime with the actual module ID.
existing_typed_owners.script_to_actor: OriginalCampaignWorldAdapter::command handles kind30 by calling OriginalCampaignWorldProviders.named_character(name,module,ActorId&,found,error), then OriginalActorLifecycle::spawn(id,error). SourceWorldObjects::named_character already implements source name/module lookup semantics.
existing_typed_owners.actor_lifecycle: OriginalActorLifecycle stores a borrowed ActorState* and delegates state, transform, enabled, collision, physical, animation and target effects through OriginalLifecycleServices. Main's existing diagnostic lifecycle setup forwards these effects to ActorPopulation, NativeBodies and the same CombatSession.
existing_typed_owners.generic_enemy: RuntimeEnemyControllerV1 consumes the same CombatSession actors after lifecycle permissions admit Idle3. Production bindEnemyAI composes its shared RuntimeEnemyNavigationV1 with the same SourceNavigationWorldStorage, PlayableActorBodies and CollisionScene.

results: Connected canonical Trigger/MGP test passed its actual source-trigger/contact/script-start assertions; the first script then stopped explicitly at the expected unbound block-save provider. It is not LizardMan_Intro live proof.

World adapter test passed two ordered kind30 source spawns and PreSpawn17 -> Spawn1 using fixture ActorState records.
Lifecycle test passed the generic same-Actor PreSpawn17 -> Spawn1 -> Idle3 state path with lifecycle effect fixtures.
current_owner_probe.separate_same_session_evidence: port/windows-foundation/reports/packaged-source-clock-runtime-v9.json records explicit scheduled LizardMan_Intro Spawn commands at frames33/128, both same-session actors reaching Idle3, and subsequent damage/death. This is genuine same-session source Spawn/combat evidence but bypasses normal trigger contact and uses scheduled script replay.
current_owner_probe.production_gap: main.cpp wires scheduled source command replay and diagnostic lifecycle, but does not construct/admit the authored LizardMan_Intro canonical TriggerZone in the same normal-play session. Current passing component tests use fixtures at one or more owner boundaries; there is no test proving trigger contact -> source script -> same-session intro actor spawn -> generic AI/death as a single production path.

minimal_root_handoff.feature_consumer_api: authored_intro_spawn_consumer_v1.hpp: bind_authored_intro_spawn_consumer_v1 validates the exact two authored 001_swamp Character identities, then composes SourceWorldObjects module-scoped name lookup with the caller-supplied actor lookup and matching OriginalActorLifecycle PreSpawn record. The actor lookup is a trusted caller contract: this API verifies stable ActorId and lifecycle-state facts but lifecycle exposes no borrowed ActorState pointer for pointer-identity comparison. It only installs OriginalCampaignWorldProviders.named_character; OriginalCampaignWorldAdapter still owns kind30 -> lifecycle.spawn.
compose_existing: Retain the existing source Module/Character/Trigger records and use the real runtime module ID from constructor receipts.
Bind the authored TriggerZone's existing CampaignBinding::trigger_script_services to the canonical trigger owner and actual contact/condition/online/local-player services.
Bind OriginalCampaignWorldProviders.named_character to the same module-scoped actor/ObjectManager identity that backs the current CombatSession ActorState records.
Register lifecycle records for these exact retained Session actors and route lifecycle effects, Spawn animation completion and combat permissions back into that same session.
Supply the reached source block-save and camera/controller providers so LizardMan_Intro can proceed through its original prefix instead of skipping ahead to Spawn.
minimal_root_handoff.do_not: Do not create a second actor registry, substitute the direct Limbus diagnostic actor, force trigger contact, schedule Spawn by frame, or report a trigger-to-combat pass from component tests.
